text: FeynCalcExternal[exp] translates exp from the internal FeynCalc representation to a shorthand form.

ex // FeynCalcInternal // StandardForm (*{DiracGamma[LorentzIndex[\[Mu]]], DiracGamma[LorentzIndex[\[Rho], D], D], DiracGamma[Momentum[p]], Pair[Momentum[p], Momentum[q]], Pair[LorentzIndex[\[Alpha]], LorentzIndex[\[Beta]]], Pair[LorentzIndex[\[Mu]], Momentum[p]]}*)
ex // FeynCalcInternal // FeynCalcExternal // StandardForm (*{GA[\[Mu]], GAD[\[Rho]], GS[p], SP[p, q], MT[\[Alpha], \[Beta]], FV[p, \[Mu]]}*)
